name: new-bundle-analysis
prompt: Git pull, then check whether a new experiment bundle has appeared under your configured results_dir since your last analysis. If none has, stay quiet — this job is a digest, not a nudger, and a run-free day is not an event worth a message. If one or more new bundles exist, analyse the newest per your SOUL and report: what the run was (infra, target connections, ports), the reconciliation of attempted vs established vs fully-measured flows, the metrics WITH their population, and anything outside normal run-to-run spread. Apply the truncation rule before quoting any statistic — if the metric block is per-flow and near the SSM cap, say the data is a prefix and refuse to compute percentiles over it rather than reporting a number you cannot stand behind. Do not dispatch anything; if a follow-up run is warranted, name it and stop.
